item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2025-8574 - WordPress
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2025-8574 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.7
Resumo:
The Database Cleaner plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary table deletion in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.7. This is due to a lack of restriction on database tables that can be deleted. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Administrator-level access and above, to delete core WordPress tables.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-8574

item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2026-119714 - WordPress
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-119714 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
My Calendar WordPress plugin 3.8.8 before 3.8.11 contains a shortcode injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute registered shortcodes via the mcs search parameter. The mcs value reaches mc_search_results() in src/my-calendar-search.php without bracket encoding before do_shortcode runs, so a GET request triggers shortcodes on any page or post, enabling content injection and spoofing.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-119714
